integrity: The proof expands the exact published survival series, justifies termwise summation using geometric decay in the mixing index, and derives the hazard and quantile corrections analytically. Numerical checks are consistency tests only.
scientific_limitations: The result is asymptotic and does not supply a uniform finite-y error bound.
Higher-order coefficients are not claimed although the same expansion method can produce them.
No universal numerical-accuracy advantage over direct quantile inversion is claimed.
title: Exact polylogarithmic tail constants and quantile correction for the LGF model
